test_quantile_toy_example: test QuantileRegressor with different quantile, alpha, and intercept parameters on a small toy dataset
test_quantile_equals_huber_for_low_epsil: test that QuantileRegressor predictions approximate HuberRegressor predictions for low epsilon values
test_quantile_estimates_calibration: test that QuantileRegressor correctly estimates the fraction of points below the predicted quantile
test_equivariance: test QuantileRegressor equivariance properties under scaling, shifting, and transformation of input data
test_sparse_input: test that QuantileRegressor produces consistent results with sparse and dense input matrices using HiGHS solvers
